Threaded / conversation view

https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/9981 https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/6197

Synchronisation

For timely synchronisation, please check the app is excluded from any battery optimisation and allowed to run in the background. This is enabled using android settings. Navigate to android settings > all apps > Thunderbird > Battery Usage

Sync is managed on a per folder basis and only enabled by default for Inbox. To toggle sync on for other folders.

1. Open the account sidebar with your account folders displayed 2. Press the manage folders button (bottom of list) 3. Tap a folder name 4. Tap "Enable Sync"

You also have the choice to enable the PUSH feature (Imap idle) which delivers emails immediately. Guide: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/configure-push-email-thunderbird-android

RBLevin said
Unified Folders don't unify.

To display the content of a folder within Unified inbox, toggle the "Unify" setting to ON.

TB have an open pull request to add unified Outbox, Drafts, Sent, Archive, Spam and Trash folders in a future update. see PR #11744

You can find more information about active and planned development on the below roadmap. https://roadmaps.thunderbird.net/en-US/android/

Feel free to share your ideas and improvement suggestions on Mozilla connect. https://connect.mozilla.org/t5/ideas/idb-p/ideas/label-name/thunderbird%20android

content:
Hi John

I can replicate your behaviour and think i can explain what's happening.

After you cleared the local messages and change the local folder size, your next step was pressing the load 100 more button. There's no mention of you synchronising the folder with the server before pressing the button.

When I replicate your steps I observe double the qty of messages downloaded compared to the local folder size value.

I believe pressing load more is doing 2 actions after local messages are cleared. 1. Performs an initial folder sync, downloads the first batch of emails (100). 2. Downloads the second batch of emails (100 more) requested because the load more button was pressed.

Can you try these steps instead. 1. Change the local folder size to your desired value (100) ++. 2. Change to a different folder, then switch back to inbox again. 3. Clear the local messages for inbox 4. Perform a pull down swipe gesture to sync the folder (loads first batch 100 emails) 5. Press the load 100 more button (only if you need an additional 100 emails).

++ I noticed the currently selected folder doesn't immediately pick up setting changes to local folder size until a different folder or account has been selected. The load x more messages button displays and uses the old values until after a change, hence step 2.

Unify

Toggling the Unify folder setting tells the app to display said folders content within the Unified Inbox. After electing to Unify sent and draft folders, it's the expected app behaviour to display their content within the Unified Inbox. Actions such as delete, move etc are performed on the original email.

The app doesn't yet have separate Unified Outbox, sent, draft, trash or Archive folders. That is a planned feature addition likely to arrive in a future update. See below for more info. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/pull/11744

content:
If you're able to access the internet, an eSIM issue sounds an unlikely cause.

Did you check the server settings and test they if the pass the connection test?

  1. Navigate to settings > account name > fetching mail > incoming server
  2. Click next.

The error may simply be that the oAuth 2.0 access toen needs renewed (if you use this authentication type). It happens occasionally. Doing the above step normally resolved the error.

The issue may also be a geo-block by your email provider. If they detect the connections from outside your home country as unusual traffic for you, they may have blocked access. Some email providers ask users to login to their web-mail and confirm they made the connection before allowing the app to reconnect.

Are you using any VPN that may be causing difficulties with the connection?
